mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_comments tc WHERE tc.task_id = t.id), 0) AS comment_count FROM task_favorites f INNER JOIN tasks t ON f.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_favorites (user_id, task_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
